crossRefs.note: Why do you set your eyes on that which is not? For it certainly sprouts wings like an eagle and flies in the sky.
Your eyes will see strange things, and your mind will imagine confusing things.
“I made a covenant with my eyes, how then should I look lustfully at a young woman?
Turn my eyes away from looking at worthless things. Revive me in your ways.
“The lamp of the body is the eye. If therefore your eye is sound, your whole body will be full of light.

translations.web: Let your eyes look straight ahead. Fix your gaze directly before you.
translations.bsb: Let your eyes look forward; fix your gaze straight ahead.
translations.kjv: Let thine eyes look right on, and let thine eyelids look straight
translations.asv: Let thine eyes look right on, And let thine eyelids look straight before thee.
